_README: Presets are ready-made blocks. Copy the desired block into "environment".
You can uncomment multiple keys at once and edit their values.
JSON does not support comments. A key starting with "//" is ignored.
After editing, save the file and run Launch ARC Raiders.command.
// HOW TO USE: 1. Copy the desired preset block from "presets" into "environment".
2. Or edit the values inside "environment" directly.
3. Save the file and start the game.
Every key below is a string (use quotes around 0 and 1).
// WINEMSYNC: 1 = MSync, native macOS primitives, can give higher FPS in games
but can sometimes be unstable on Apple silicon
// CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND: d3dmetal - translation via D3DMetal (recommended, the most tested)
dxmt     - alternative DXMT backend (may be faster, less predictable)
wine     - classic translation without D3DMetal/DXMT (very slow, rarely needed)
// D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX: 1 = enabled, can improve picture quality and performance,
but requires that the game supports this path
// DXMT_ENABLE_NVEXT: 1 = enabled, makes sense only if CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND = "dxmt"
